The startup’s target group includes both homeowners and contractors. “Building material procurement in India has remained fragmented and inefficient. We're making it as reliable, transparent and fast as any modern commerce experience,” said Pukhraj Grewal, founder and chief executive. Grewal had previously cofounded Tornado, a tech-led interior contracting startup, and Project Hero, a construction labour-hiring platform. Over the past 12 months, HomeRun has delivered over 100,000 orders and grown eight-fold across top categories. It raised $6.6 million in February. Commenting on the funding, Anand Datta, Partner, Nexus Venture Partners, said, “Our quick commerce thesis centres on formalizing supply chains while preserving the proximity advantage of small-format local merchants.
